baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يوم / ينفخ / الصور / تأتون / أفواجا joins an event-day, a passive blast, the horn, arrival, and human groups.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe event is keyed to wind sent into the horn; the blast functions as the transition after which the addressees arrive in successive human batches.

activation_trace.role: The event-day or severe occasion makes the time a decisive occurrence rather than an ordinary daylight interval.
Wind sent into something supplies the initiating blast.
The blown horn fixes the instrument selected by the adjacent blowing construction.
Coming and arriving supplies movement into the event.
A human band, including group after group, supplies a serial muster rather than one undifferentiated crowd.

changed_reading.before: At some time a horn is blown and people come in groups.
changed_reading.after: A decisive blast converts the addressed plurality into successive arriving cohorts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ينفخ and الصور retain branch images of air-filled swelling and formed bodily shape alongside the dominant horn branch, immediately before تأتون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can carry a secondary material image in which formed bodies are filled or raised and only then become arrivals; the crowd is produced by reanimation, not merely summoned from an already active state.

activation_trace.role: Swelling or filling with air supplies a material reanimation image.
Formed creaturely shape supplies the bodies on which the filling image operates.
Arrival is the first action of the reactivated forms.
Human groups make the reanimation collective and serial.

changed_reading.before: The blast externally summons an already constituted crowd.
changed_reading.after: The blast may also image the reconstitution of formed bodies whose first movement is to arrive in cohorts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تأتون and أفواجا activate road, watercourse, traveled limit, and broad-pass images within the focus roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival is organized by channels and apertures: groups are not only counted batches but pulses whose shape is imposed by the routes through which they pass.

activation_trace.role: A traveled road, road junction, and terminal limit supplies an arrival route and endpoint.
The broad opening between elevations supplies the spatial width that channels each arriving batch.

changed_reading.before: Afwaj only reports how many social batches arrive.
changed_reading.after: Afwaj also pictures route-shaped waves moving through broad approaches toward a terminal assembly.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual questioning concerns an arriving report over which people take divergent paths; the promised disclosure is realized when the addressees no longer discuss the event at a distance but physically arrive inside it.

activation_trace.role: Arrival anchors the epistemic change in the focus clause as embodied presence.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the opening state of unresolved exchange.
A transmitted report that comes to its hearers supplies the disputed event in verbal form.
Each taking a path unlike the other supplies divergent readings before the event.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised resolution that arrival enacts.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 moves from a question, through a disputed report, to a twice-repeated future knowing.
The second-person plural of 78:18 turns the earlier discussants into participants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, report, divergence, disclosure, and arrival; I supply the arrow from verbal controversy to compulsory first-person evidence. A live alternative is that the opening only frames disbelief while 78:18 remains a physical summons without an epistemic function.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely travel to a future gathering.
changed_reading.after: Those who exchanged questions over the report are made to enter it, so coming in groups is the report's conversion from disputed speech into disclosed presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding appointment is specifically for separation and judgment, while the later scene places beings in a straight rank; successive groups therefore become functional cohorts for sorting and ordered placement.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day anchors the appointment as the focus time.
Successive human groups provide the units that can be sorted and placed.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood gives the gathering a classificatory purpose.
A fixed appointment makes the blast the execution of a scheduled transition.
Alignment on a straight line supplies the ordered form toward which the arriving cohorts move.

structural_cues: 78:17 is the immediate syntactic and temporal head for 78:18.
78:38 repeats the day-frame and depicts a rank after the earlier arrival in groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed separation, successive groups, and a later straight rank; I infer that the arrival batches are already adjudicatively legible. They could alternatively be logistical waves that are sorted only after arrival.

changed_reading.after: People arrive as appointment-bound cohorts whose plurality serves separation and ordered placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cosmos first presented as fixed and built is reversed immediately after the blast: the closed height becomes entrances and the anchored elevations are displaced into mirage. The road and broad-pass branches in the focus arrival now describe transit through a newly reconfigured world.

activation_trace.role: A traveled road, junction, and terminal limit anchor the focus arrival as routed motion.
A wide pass between elevations supplies the aperture through which a cohort can be shaped.
Stake-like standing and fixity supply the pre-event stability that will be reversed.
Construction by joining parts supplies the initially closed architecture above.
The opening of what was closed and widening of an entrance converts architecture into access.
An entrance gives the opened height a transit function.
Removal and displacement undo the mountains' former anchoring role.
Mirage-like appearance makes the former barrier visually present but materially unavailable.

structural_cues: 78:6-13 builds a habitable, fixed vertical order before the focus.
78:19-20 immediately turns the sky into doors and mountains into mirage after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, anchoring, opening, entrances, displacement, and mirage; I infer that this reversal creates the transit topology for تأتون أفواجا. A live alternative is that the cosmic changes are signs accompanying the gathering, not literal routes used by it.

changed_reading.before: Groups approach an unspecified assembly across an unchanged world.
changed_reading.after: Their coming is a routed crossing made possible when fixed cosmic boundaries are opened and former barriers lose substance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence explicitly delivers and pours water so that hidden growth exits the earth. Focus branches of spring swelling, formed shape, and produced yield let the horn-to-arrival sequence replay that causal pattern at the scale of human life.

activation_trace.role: Spring swelling and rising ground connect the blast root to renewed emergence.
Formed creaturely shape supplies the human material that reappears.
Produced yield and increase recast arrival as the output of renewed life.
Delivery downward supplies the initiating input of the growth sequence.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the medium that reaches latent life.
Pouring and outflow make the delivery abundant and activating.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the resulting emergence.
Vegetation exiting the earth gives a visible model of life appearing after activation.

structural_cues: 78:14-16 gives an input-to-emergence sequence directly before the appointed day.
The purpose construction in 78:15 explicitly links the delivered water to bringing forth growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the water-to-emergence arrow and focus branches of swelling, form, and yield; I map that arrow onto blast-to-human-arrival. The alternative is that growth demonstrates creative power without modeling the mechanics of the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The horn is a signal that gathers living hearers.
changed_reading.after: The blast also reenacts the surah's emergence pattern, activating formed life so that humanity appears as a collective yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death-like sleep and a cutting cessation precede the focus, while resurrection-standing follows it; the horn therefore functions like the signal ending a universal suspension, and arrival becomes collective waking into standing.

activation_trace.role: The blast supplies the wake signal that terminates suspension.
Coming is the resumed action produced by awakening.
Death and causing death within the sleep root make ordinary sleep a rehearsal of suspension.
Cutting and removal supply the interruption of prior activity.
Resurrection and standing of the Hour supply the post-awakening posture.

structural_cues: 78:9 places recurrent sleep-as-cessation inside the creation signs before the focus.
78:38 returns to the same day with explicit standing after the group arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sleep, cessation, blast, arrival, and resurrection-standing; I infer a daily-rest-to-final-waking analogy. The sleep sign may alternatively remain an independent benefaction rather than a rehearsal of the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The blast summons mobile populations to a meeting.
changed_reading.after: The blast ends a death-like cessation, so coming in groups is humanity's collective waking and resumption of movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence assigns a prepared return to limit-crossers and safety or winning escape to those who protect themselves; the repeated return-language later opens a route toward the Lord. Afwaj can therefore mark trajectories and destinations, not arbitrary crowd slices.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the movement whose destination the later blocks specify.
Human cohorts supply the plurality that can diverge by trajectory and outcome.
Preparation in advance makes one destination already positioned to receive its cohort.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the criterion for one trajectory.
Return to an abode gives that trajectory a terminal place.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the contrasting cohort criterion.
Winning good and escaping harm supplies the contrasting outcome.
The repeated return-to-abode image also frames a deliberately taken route toward the Lord.

structural_cues: 78:21-30 and 78:31-36 form consecutive contrasting outcome blocks after the gathering.
78:39 reuses مآبا for a route deliberately taken toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared destinations, limit-crossing, self-protection, escape, and return; I infer that these trajectories classify the arriving afwaj. The groups could instead be neutral arrival batches whose members receive destinations only later.

changed_reading.before: The groups differ only by arrival order or social grouping.
changed_reading.after: The cohorts arrive already shadowed by divergent returns: prepared capture, protected escape, and the possible route toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Total enumeration, entry into a written register or cohort, and final inspection of each person's prior handiwork prevent mass arrival from erasing agency. Afwaj is an assembly format whose members remain individually legible.

activation_trace.role: The human group anchors the tension between collective arrival and individual identity.
Comprehensive enclosure and totality exclude omissions within the crowd.
Enumeration by exhaustive counting makes each item retrievable.
Entering a name into a register or cohort supplies administrative legibility inside group structure.
The individual person restores singular accountability at the surah's end.
Advancing something ahead supplies the personal history that precedes each arrival.
What the two hands earned ties the inspected record to embodied personal action.

structural_cues: 78:29 places exhaustive recording inside the judgment block soon after the gathering.
78:40 closes with each person viewing what that person's own hands advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total recording and singular self-inspection; I infer that afwaj organizes transport or adjudication without becoming the unit of moral liability. The book could alternatively signify exhaustive knowledge without implying literal cohort registries.

changed_reading.before: People arrive as masses whose group identity dominates the scene.
changed_reading.after: They arrive in administratively legible cohorts, yet every member carries an individually exhaustive history into the assembly.

context_deltas.mechanism: One passive horn signal is universally effective, but at the destination the assembled ranks neither control address nor speak without permission and correctness. This asymmetry makes the blast an operative command within a sovereign speech-order rather than mere information.

activation_trace.role: Sent wind supplies the one sound-producing act that moves the scene.
The horn gives that act a public signal-form.
Possession and power of disposal clarify what the assembled do not control with respect to address.
Reciprocal address supplies the communicative capacity denied before the ranked scene.
Straight alignment supplies the disciplined posture of those reached by the signal.
Meaningful speech between speakers marks the action generally withheld.
Permission supplies the gate through which any response may occur.
Uttered saying supplies the exceptional authorized response.
Rightness settled opposite error constrains the content of that response.

structural_cues: 78:18 contains an effective sound whose agent is left implicit and whose result is immediate collective movement.
78:37-38 narrows possession of address and then conditions speech on permission and rightness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the effective blast and the later restrictions on address, speech, permission, and correctness; I infer a single authority regime governing both. A live alternative is that the blast and courtroom speech protocol are adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: The horn merely announces that it is time to gather.
changed_reading.after: The horn is an efficacious command: all move at its sound, while the resulting ranks possess no reciprocal speech except what is authorized and right.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because في الصور and the horn branch strongly favor a trumpet, not bodily forms. It remains anchored in the focus through the air-filled swelling branch of نفخ, the formed-shape branch of صور, and the following arrival, while the later resurrection-standing keeps the mechanism live. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material resonance, never as a replacement translation of الصور.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of ينفخ, الصور, and تأتون permits a contained image of formed bodies being filled before they move.

activation_trace.role: Air-filled swelling supplies the material change that precedes motion.
Formed creaturely shape supplies the object of that material change.
Arrival supplies the first resulting movement of the filled forms.
Resurrection and standing keep the reanimation resonance contextually anchored.

changed_reading.before: A trumpet blast calls bodies that are already active.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary material level, blowing fills formed bodies into renewed activity, and their arrival is the visible effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is cross-domain because people are not literally water and أفواجا ordinarily names human groups. It remains anchored in the focus through the watercourse and incoming-torrent branches of أتى and the broad-opening branch of فوج, with contextual outflow, opening, and seepage. Downstream prose should call this a flow analogy for crowd routing, not a lexical gloss or claim of literal inundation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تأتون أفواجا can be pictured through the focus roots' channel, incoming torrent, and broad-pass images.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse and the clearing of flow supply the channel for mass movement.
A torrent arriving from elsewhere supplies the surge-like quality of coming.
A broad opening between elevations supplies the pass that divides or admits each surge.
Pouring and outflow establish the surah's prior model of abundant directed movement.
Water bursting from an outlet links opening with released flow.
Water running, seeping, and dripping extends the flow topology beyond the focus.

changed_reading.before: Discrete social batches walk toward the assembly.
changed_reading.after: The assembly can also be imagined as human surges channeled through newly released openings, with routes shaping the afwaj.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The answering-bird branch of صور is form-distant and cannot displace the horn fixed by ينفخ. It remains worth carrying because that branch contributes a caller-response relation directly between the blast and تأتون, and the later permission structure confirms that response is controlled. Downstream prose should mark it as a branch echo that sharpens responsiveness, never render الصور as a bird.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The horn blast followed by second-person arrival is sharpened by a صور branch image of a bird that answers when called.

activation_trace.role: The blast supplies the audible call.
A bird answering a caller supplies a surprising response relation without replacing the horn sense.
Arrival supplies the enacted answer to the call.
Successive human groups make the response universal but serial.
Permission later constrains who may answer, reinforcing controlled responsiveness.

changed_reading.before: The crowd happens to arrive after hearing a signal.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival is an enacted answer to a call whose authority organizes every cohort and controls any later reply.

strongest_changes: The disputed report becomes compulsory presence: earlier questioners enter the event they debated.
Generic batches become appointment-bound cohorts shaped by separation, cosmic routes, and divergent destinations.
Creation, irrigation, sleep, and later standing activate arrival as collective re-emergence rather than transport alone.
The mass gathering preserves exhaustive personal records and enters a speech-order in which the blast commands all but replies require permission.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah sequence lets creation, rest, growth, cosmic opening, judgment, record, and authorized speech assign different functions to the five focus roots without collapsing the dominant horn-and-muster reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The horn branch and the grammar of في الصور remain dominant; formed-body, answering-call, and hydraulic branches should remain qualified resonances.
Afwaj can encode serial arrival, adjudicative classes, route-shaped waves, or destination cohorts, and the packet does not force one grouping criterion.
Because ينفخ is passive, the signal's agent and its authority are inferred from the later speech restrictions rather than named in the focus ayah.
